title: Binding
description: Per-environment wiring: which credential authenticates against which endpoint, and which provider implements which capability. A 'none' provider is a legal, explicit binding checked against the profile policy.

capabilities.description: Which provider implements each capability for this environment. A value is a provider id, or {provider, endpoint} to pin a specific endpoint; otherwise the provider's registry manifest supplies the endpoint_kind that resolves the endpoint (capability -> provider -> endpoint_kind -> endpoint). Consumed on the deploy attestation path (artifact-attestation); the remaining capabilities resolve through the same chain as their runtimes are wired.
